newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGE to pay 3.4 bln Ffr for Alcatel's Havas shares.
newsitem.headline: CGE to pay 3.4 bln Ffr for Alcatel's Havas shares.

text.p: Cie Generale des Eaux will pay 3.4 billion francs for shares in Havas owned by Alcatel, Generale des Eaux head Jean-Marie Messier said on Thursday.
He was announcing a deal with Havas at a news conference in which Generale des Eaux will sell its stake in pay-television broadcast group Canal Plus and in return increase its stake in Havas.
Messier said the entire operation would mean cash outflow for Generale des Eaux of 2.3 billion francs.
This included the cost of buying the Alcatel shares. "We are buying Alcatel shares in Havas for 3.4 billion," he said.

Generale des Eaux will also save 500 million since it will no longer be carrying the debt of its Generale d'Images unit, which it is selling to Havas, and get 600 million francs through the sale of its cable activities and its 10 percent stake in CanalSatellite.
